the applicability of NAT-Traversal techniques in home networks and how they can be used to improve the communication of services across NATs.
the applicability of existing and novel NAT-Traversal techniques in a home network environment.

the development of a knowledge based NAT-Traversal framework, which will be able to select the most appropriate NAT-Traversal technique based on the service category of an application and the type of NAT.

a knowledge driven NAT-traversal approach is the most suitable for the majority of applications and NATs, but that there are still a lot of open questions that need to be answered before such an approach can be used in real life scenarios.
